events.description: Follow-up after the renal biopsy period recorded in the outcome table

evidence.quote: 1 | Liver | Sorafenib | VEGFR | NA | 105 | CR | TMA
Follow-up data included post-biopsy therapeutic interventions, serial assessments of serum creatinine and proteinuria, along with oncological outcomes.

summary.text: A male patient aged 55 years with liver cancer had received the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Sorafenib for 105 months. The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema present and change in hypertension absent at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is not available.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as TMA. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 1.0 (86) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 2.14 g/day and serum albumin 28.7 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as yes, and the creatinine trajectory group is recovery group.

The Table 5 treatment and outcome row lists TKI discontinuation, ACEI/ARB therapy, with follow-up of 43 months, serum creatinine 0.7 (59) at follow-up and proteinuria remission status PR. Renal survival is listed as CKD 2.

summary.text: A male patient aged 63 years with gastrointestinal stromal tumor had received the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Sunitinib for 24 months. The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema absent and change in hypertension present at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is not available.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as TMA + IgAN. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 1.2 (108) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 1.52 g/day and serum albumin 30.8 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as yes, and the creatinine trajectory group is recovery group.

The Table 5 treatment and outcome row lists ACEI/ARB therapy, immunosuppressant therapy (Pred), with follow-up of 13 months, serum creatinine 0.8 (69) at follow-up and proteinuria remission status NR. The table lists the patient as dead.

The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema absent and change in hypertension absent at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is not available.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as IgAN + ATIN. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 2.8 (251) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 2.19 g/day and serum albumin 29.6 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as no, and the creatinine trajectory group is recovery group.

The Table 5 treatment and outcome row lists TKI discontinuation, an alternative TKI (Ametinib → crizotinib), immunosuppressant therapy (TG), with follow-up of 3 months, serum creatinine 1.9 (171) at follow-up and proteinuria remission status PR. Renal survival is listed as CKD 3.

summary.text: A male patient aged 51 years with liver cancer had received the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Lenvatinib for 18 months. The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema present and change in hypertension absent at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is not available.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as TMA + FSGS. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 0.6 (53) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 2.31 g/day and serum albumin 21.5 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as yes, and the creatinine trajectory group is stability group.

The Table 5 treatment and outcome row lists TKI discontinuation, an alternative TKI (Lenvatinib → regorafenib), ACEI/ARB therapy, with follow-up of 9 months, serum creatinine 0.7 (59) at follow-up and proteinuria remission status NR. Renal survival is listed as CKD 1.

summary.text: A male patient aged 54 years with stomach cancer had received the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Apatinib for 53 months. The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema present and change in hypertension present at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is not available.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as IgAN + TMA. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 1.4 (123) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 2.8 g/day and serum albumin 31.7 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as yes, and the creatinine trajectory group is stability group.

The Table 5 treatment and outcome row lists TKI discontinuation, ACEI/ARB therapy, with follow-up of 5.5 months, serum creatinine 1.4 (127) at follow-up and proteinuria remission status PR. Renal survival is listed as CKD 3.

evidence.quote: Follow-up data included post-biopsy therapeutic interventions, serial assessments of serum creatinine and proteinuria, along with oncological outcomes.

summary.text: A male patient aged 59 years with gastrointestinal stromal tumor had received the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Sunitinib for 26 months. The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema absent and change in hypertension present at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is not available.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as TMA. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 1.4 (121) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 0.86 g/day and serum albumin 29.7 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as no, and the creatinine trajectory group is stability group.

The Table 5 treatment and outcome row lists ACEI/ARB therapy, with follow-up of 1 months, serum creatinine 1.4 (125) at follow-up and proteinuria remission status NR. Renal survival is listed as CKD 3.

17 | Liver | Lenvatinib | VEGFR | TDF | 41 | PD | TMA + FSGS

summary.text: A male patient aged 69 years with liver cancer had received the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Lenvatinib for 41 months. The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema present and change in hypertension present at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is listed as Tenofovir disoproxil.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as TMA + FSGS. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 1.3 (111) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 3.44 g/day and serum albumin 32.5 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as yes, and the creatinine trajectory group is not assessable.

summary.text: A male patient aged 49 years with gastrointestinal stromal tumor had received the tyrosine kinase inhibitor Ripretinib for 25 months. The case series lists this patient as having biopsy-proven TKI-associated renal injury, with edema absent and change in hypertension absent at the time of renal biopsy. Concomitant medication is not available.

Renal biopsy findings were reported as TMA + FSGS. At the time of renal biopsy, the table gives serum creatinine 1.1 (95) mg/dL (micromole per liter in parentheses), proteinuria 1.41 g/day and serum albumin 38.7 g/L. Nephrotic syndrome is recorded as no, and the creatinine trajectory group is not assessable.
